name: How do I choose the best slip-resistant flooring for my shower remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best slip-resistant flooring for my shower remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the best slip-resistant flooring involves considering factors like the material's COF rating, your aesthetic preferences, maintenance requirements, and budget. For maximum safety, look for tiles with a high R-value or DCOF (Dynamic Coefficient of Friction). Consider the overall bathroom design to ensure the flooring complements other elements. Discuss options like textured ceramic, porcelain, or specialized composite materials with your contractor to find a balance between safety, style, and practicality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select slip-resistant flooring based on its COF rating, aesthetics, maintenance, and budget, often with contractor guidance.
